# Pixel-sort wipe

A wipe with a glitch-art edge: behind the moving front, each line of the next image appears sorted by brightness, as if a pixel sort were running along the direction of travel, before it settles into the image.

<EffectDemo effect="sort-wipe" />

## Usage

```ts
import { createTransition, toHoloEffect } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { sortWipe } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/sort-wipe';

const effect = sortWipe({ preset: 'rain' });

// Standalone: blend two textures as progress goes from 0 to 1.
const player = createTransition(renderer, effect, {
  from: textureA,
  to: textureB,
});
player.progress = 0.5;
player.render();

// With HoloCSS: hand it to transition3d().
import { transition3d } from '@mk7s/holocss/three';
await transition3d(fromElement, toElement, toHoloEffect(effect), {
  target,
  update,
});
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.angle = -90`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type    | Default | Range        | Description                                            |
| --------- | ------- | ------- | ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `angle`   | number  | `-90`   | -180 – 180 ° | Direction the front travels (-90 is downward).         |
| `band`    | number  | `0.35`  | 0.02 – 1     | Length of the sorted band, as a fraction of the frame. |
| `reverse` | boolean | `false` |              | Sort brightest first instead of darkest first.         |
| `samples` | integer | `24`    | 4 – 32       | Samples along each streak: more are smoother.          |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset     | Settings                     |
| ---------- | ---------------------------- |
| `rain`     | `angle: -90`, `band: 0.5`    |
| `sideways` | `angle: 0`, `band: 0.25`     |
| `bright`   | `reverse: true`, `band: 0.5` |

Apply one with `sortWipe({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Transitions · tracked as story X13.6 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Kind:** transition. `createTransition(renderer, effect, { from, to })` runs it on two textures; `toHoloEffect(effect)` turns it into a HoloCSS `ThreeEffect` (parameters are baked in when called), with the `hcss-flip-y` CSS fallback. See [transitions](/guide/transitions).
- **Motion:** driven by `progress` from your timeline. HoloCSS skips transitions when motion is off; standalone, set `progress = 1` instead of animating.
- **Size:** 6.1 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/sort-wipe`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: Single-pass approximation of a pixel-sort front: brightest-above-threshold sample carried along the direction of travel.

## Related

- [Pixel sort](./pixel-sort) — Sorts runs of pixels by brightness or hue along rows or columns, the glitch-art streaks of pixel sorting.
- [Wipe](./wipe) — Reveals the next image behind a moving edge: a straight line at any angle, a circle growing from a center, or a clock hand sweeping around it.
- [Glitch cut](./glitch-cut) — Cuts to the next image through digital damage: blocks flip over one by one around the middle while slices shift and the color channels split.
